body:
I've observed similar issues when using menu keyboard shortcuts (typically Command-S to save) since 4.5 builds without switching in/out of the Godot window, but then having the 2d/3d view editors apparently missing the command key up event in the same way and staying in snapping mode until you press and release key command again. (see very old related issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/59687)

So I'm not sure this is such a recent regression, it could be that it's just the recently (4.5.1?) added movement snapping in the editor views that makes this issue noticeable. Or it might even be that this is an issue specific to how this snapping feature detects if the snapping modifier key is held down or not.
